tour_seo_1.name: Me
tour_seo_1.text: *We stand side by side in front of the school gate. The very spot where Seoyeon was waiting on Day 1.*

tour_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_2.text: This is where we first met.

tour_seo_3.name: Me
tour_seo_3.text: I almost got in trouble for saying 'more than I deserve' back then.

tour_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_4.text: I didn't actually scold you, did I? — I liked you from that moment.

tour_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_6.text: ...It might've been a trick of the wind.

tour_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_8.text: After graduation, I want to be someone who works for others.

tour_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_10.text: As myself, not the president. — You showed me that. That it's okay even without the title.

tour_seo_end.name: Me
tour_seo_end.text: *Seoyeon smiled quietly. Sunlight slants down over the school gate.*

tour_yuna_1.name: Me
tour_yuna_1.text: *The library reading room. The seat where Yuna said 'if you're not too loud' on Day 1.*

tour_yuna_3.name: Me
tour_yuna_3.text: *Yuna sits down in the same seat as that day.*

tour_yuna_4.name: Me
tour_yuna_4.text: This is where I first sat.

tour_yuna_5.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_5.text: ...You picked up three books that time.

tour_yuna_8.name: Me
tour_yuna_8.text: *A short sentence, but — five days' worth of feeling is packed into 'I remember everything.'*

tour_yuna_end.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_end.text: ...I'd like you to read them. As my first reader.

tour_dain_1.name: Me
tour_dain_1.text: *The store bench. The spot where we ate melon bread on Day 1.*

tour_dain_4.name: Dain
tour_dain_4.text: You're STILL bringing that up?! — Oh, but that melon bread really was delicious.

tour_dain_6.name: Dain
tour_dain_6.text: Going pro... I'm not sure about that anymore.

tour_dain_8.name: Dain
tour_dain_8.text: But sometimes I get scared. Scared of becoming someone without a dream.

tour_dain_9.name: Me
tour_dain_9.text: You can just find a new dream.

tour_dain_10.name: Dain
tour_dain_10.text: ...Yeah. When you put it that way, it feels like it could actually happen.

tour_dain_end.name: Me
tour_dain_end.text: *She smiles. Half-moon eyes. — The same eyes I first saw on Day 1, but with a different depth.*

tour_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_freetalk.text: *Standing on the rooftop with Seoyeon. The last lunch break.*
tour_seo_freetalk.context: Day 5 last lunch, with Seoyeon. The end is approaching. Tone: Both know this is the last time. Laughing but with a tinge of bittersweetness. More honest than usual, everything feels precious.
tour_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool student council president. Being the last time, her usual composure is gone and true feelings emerge.

tour_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_freetalk.text: *Standing in the library with Yuna. The last lunch break.*
tour_yuna_freetalk.context: Day 5 last lunch, with Yuna. The end is approaching. Tone: Both know this is the last time. Laughing but with a tinge of bittersweetness. More honest than usual, everything feels precious.
tour_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. Being the last time, her walls are completely down. Her sentences are much longer than usual.

tour_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
tour_dain_freetalk.text: *Standing in the gym with Dain. The last lunch break.*
tour_dain_freetalk.context: Day 5 last lunch, with Dain. The end is approaching. Tone: Both know this is the last time. Laughing but with a tinge of bittersweetness. More honest than usual, everything feels precious.
tour_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete. Being the last time, she can't maintain her cheerful facade. Real emotions show through.
